requirement: The infrastructure shall provision a Cognito user pool, user-pool client, and identity pool, and link the identity pool to that Cognito provider. Operators shall be able to set the validity units for access, ID, and refresh tokens to days, hours, minutes, or seconds; the user-pool client shall support reading and writing the email and custom:Role attributes.

The identity pool shall permit authenticated and unauthenticated identities and associate each access path with its corresponding IAM role. The unauthenticated role shall be assumable only by unauthenticated web identities from the created identity pool, and its permissions shall be limited to the unauthenticated-access actions defined in the deployment template.

The infrastructure shall deploy the WhoAmI and ECS API methods to the configured API Gateway stage, protect methods requiring authentication with a Cognito user-pool authorizer, and publish the deployed API endpoint URL as a deployment output. The gateway shall support using the Cognito user-pool ARN supplied from a separate AWS account.

API Gateway shall obtain role information from the authenticated Cognito custom:Role claim, expose it through the optional x-pagopa-pn-cx-role response header on WhoAmI, and forward the same role information to the ECS backend through the x-pagopa-pn-cx-role request header.

The infrastructure shall provide private Amazon SQS access through an interface VPC endpoint in the configured VPC and subnets, using the regional SQS service name and private DNS. Its endpoint security group shall allow inbound TCP access only from the configured VPC CIDR.

Operators shall be able to deploy the infrastructure using AWS CloudFormation YAML templates and installation scripts configured with environment names, AWS account and region settings, CLI profiles, network settings, domain values, and required service API keys.
API Gateway shall route requests for the ECS backend through a VPC link to an operator-supplied network load balancer, using its ARN and the configured integration URI.
